resources.string: "Sign in to your account to use MyScript Notes’ generative AI features. If you don't have an account, you can create one – it’s free!"
Unable to complete your request using this selection. Please select less text and try again.
Note: AI-generated content may contain inaccurate information.
Please connect to the internet and retry.
Unable to complete your request using this selection. Please select more text and try again.
To try MyScript Notes’ new AI features, select some text and tap the ✨ button.
Quiz features work best with text content – avoid creating quizzes from diagrams or notes containing mostly images.
Ready for a quiz? You got this! Just choose the correct answer from the options displayed.
Boost learning by answering quizzes generated from your content.
New in MyScript Notes’ AI features
Time to test your knowledge. Read each statement, then choose whether it’s true or false. Good luck!
While MyScript Notes’ new AI features are in beta, we implement limits to ensure everyone gets a chance to enjoy them. Please try again tomorrow.
What do you want to summarize?
Something went wrong. Please try again later or visit the Help center for assistance.
MyScript Notes collects anonymized analytical data which we use to enhance your experience. Check our privacy policy for the specifics (analytics providers, data collected, etc).
The “Analytics” paragraph in our privacy policy gives more details on which provider(s) we use on which platform and what they collect.

"Effortlessly sync your content across all your devices. Auto-sync is enabled by default, but you can switch it off anytime in Settings. ⚠️ Auto-sync doesn’t back up your content, please use the separate Back up option in Settings."
To secure your data, go to Settings and back up your notes on your device regularly. For any issues, contact our support team via the Help section.
Uninstalling MyScript Notes will permanently delete your notes
Your collections and notebooks could not be backed up successfully. Please contact support.
Back up requires %s. You can free up space by managing your storage in Settings.
Your notes could not be backed up successfully. Please contact support.
Please activate your account with the link sent to %s
"Thank you for trying Nebo. Feel free to sign in when you're ready."
Your device is almost full. Empty trash or manage storage in device settings.
To make purchases, add a Google account to this device. You can set one up in the Play Store.
Please change permissions in Settings to allow Nebo access to your camera.
Please connect to internet to sign in.
Link invalid. Could not be opened.
Please update MyScript Notes or use a compatible device.
Please connect to internet to change your preference.
Please connect to internet or try again later to change your preference.
Cloud sync allows you to store and retrieve all your notes remotely.
Brightness is inverted in Dark Mode. Switch to Light Mode for real color accuracy.
Google Play services must be enabled for %1$s.
Install Google Play services to continue using %1$s.
"%1$s couldn't connect to Google Play services. Please sign-in to your Google account."
"%1$s couldn't connect to Google Play services. Please try again."
%1$s is having trouble with Google Play services. Please try again.
"%1$s can't run because your device doesn't support Google Play services. Please use a supported device."
Update Google Play services to use %1$s.
%1$s will be available once the Google Play services update is complete.
Update Google Play services to use %1$s.
It will be permanently deleted from MyScript Notes and %s.
It will be permanently deleted from MyScript Notes.
Your customized colors will be lost.
Some pages look off. Try reopening them.
This note looks off. Try writing and closing.
Some notes look off. Try reopening them.
This page looks off. Try writing and closing.
Please have a look to see if you can fix my corrupt notebook. I am using Nebo %1$s (%2$s) on Android %3$s. Thank you.
